snippet.title: When Sirens Fall Silent | Act I: The Kidnapped [The Extended Cut]
snippet.description:
When Sirens Fall Silent is a violent and deeply emotional psychological thriller set in the outskirts of Rome in the early 1990s. This is a grounded investigation into kidnappings, trauma and the cost of confronting a past you cannot escape.

We are proud to reveal our next collaboration with LKA. It is not a sequel, but it lives in the same world as The Town of Light and Martha Is Dead. LKA are pushing Unreal Engine 5 hard with layered emotional dialogue, detailed crime scenes and an atmosphere that twists around the player.

The first news report is here, after premiering during PC Gaming’s Most Wanted from PC Gamer. Watch it and tell us your thoughts.
